intro: Togo has a new parliamentary system adopted in 2024, but the same family has held power since 1967.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The President of the Council of Ministers leads the government and is chosen by parliament; the president of the republic is ceremonial. Critics say the change lets Faure Gnassingbé stay in power without term limits.

chapters.title: Protests
text: Protests in 2025 against the changes were met with force.

keyTerms.meaning: A rule that limits how long a leader can serve.
